_doc: Corrections to accepted posts, made by eye after the second pass's readers flagged them (each checked on a 14 m crop of 2022 beside 2020, 2026-11-24). remove: the post nearest E,N within 1.5 m is dropped (move, reclass and flag match the same way). move: it is moved to the new E,N (position_from says so). flag: a note on its position. Not acted on: R118's 'three squares for two poles' (the 2022 picture shows three shadows: a short post and two tall poles) and R108's 'parking meters?' (2.0-2.3 m shadows against 1.1-1.3 m for the meters beside them). reclass: the post's class is changed. The posts refutation's findings (refutation/posts_round1.json) are applied here and in eye/verdicts_refute_r1.json (its misses). After posts refutation round 3 the settled signal_post definition was applied lap-wide to every post's own eye note (reclass entries quoting the note).
